records.key: Gold haze over a brown-black room, nebula fields moving slowly through it, and a sound set in F Dorian at 120 BPM.
records.source: Gold haze over a brown-black room, nebula fields moving slowly through it, and a sound set in F Dorian at 120 BPM.
records.translation: Bruma dorada en una habitación marrón casi negra, campos de nebulosas que se mueven lentamente y un conjunto de sonidos en fa dórico a 120 BPM.

records.key: The long low light of a year's turn: olive and pale gold, cells drifting through it, and a sound set in G Lydian at 112 BPM.
records.source: The long low light of a year's turn: olive and pale gold, cells drifting through it, and a sound set in G Lydian at 112 BPM.
records.translation: La luz larga y rasante del cambio de año: verde oliva y oro pálido, células que flotan y un conjunto de sonidos en sol lidio a 112 BPM.

records.key: Deep water, green-black and slow: rings spreading and fading, and a sound set in E minor at 116 BPM with the heaviest sub of the ten.
records.source: Deep water, green-black and slow: rings spreading and fading, and a sound set in E minor at 116 BPM with the heaviest sub of the ten.
records.translation: Agua profunda, verde casi negra y lenta: anillos que se expanden y desvanecen, con un conjunto de sonidos en mi menor a 116 BPM y el subgrave más intenso de los diez.

records.key: A teal horizon line with curtains of light folding above it, and a sound set in A Dorian at 124 BPM.
records.source: A teal horizon line with curtains of light folding above it, and a sound set in A Dorian at 124 BPM.
records.translation: Una línea de horizonte turquesa con cortinas de luz que se pliegan encima y un conjunto de sonidos en la dórico a 124 BPM.

records.key: Thin high cloud: pale ice blue, barely coloured, a starfield behind it, and the most open sound set of the ten, in B minor at 126 BPM.
records.source: Thin high cloud: pale ice blue, barely coloured, a starfield behind it, and the most open sound set of the ten, in B minor at 126 BPM.
records.translation: Nubes altas y finas: azul hielo pálido, apenas coloreado, un campo de estrellas detrás y el conjunto de sonidos más espacioso de los diez, en si menor a 126 BPM.

records.key: Indigo, a starfield and the slowest sound set of the ten — C sharp minor at 108 BPM, long decays and almost no drum.
records.source: Indigo, a starfield and the slowest sound set of the ten — C sharp minor at 108 BPM, long decays and almost no drum.
records.translation: Índigo, un campo de estrellas y el conjunto de sonidos más lento de los diez: do sostenido menor a 108 BPM, decaimientos largos y casi sin percusión.

records.key: Magenta on black with nebula fields turning through it, and the hardest-pumping sound set of the ten, in F sharp minor at 128 BPM.
records.source: Magenta on black with nebula fields turning through it, and the hardest-pumping sound set of the ten, in F sharp minor at 128 BPM.
records.translation: Magenta sobre negro con campos de nebulosas giratorios y el conjunto de sonidos más enérgico de los diez, en fa sostenido menor a 128 BPM.

records.key: The last colour in the sky: plum and dusty rose, curtains of light folding overhead, and a soft sound set in E flat minor at 114 BPM.
records.source: The last colour in the sky: plum and dusty rose, curtains of light folding overhead, and a soft sound set in E flat minor at 114 BPM.
records.translation: El último color del cielo: ciruela y rosa apagado, cortinas de luz que se pliegan arriba y un conjunto de sonidos suave en mi bemol menor a 114 BPM.

records.key: White text and outlines on black with a yellow accent, for low vision and bright rooms.
records.source: White text and outlines on black with a yellow accent, for low vision and bright rooms.
records.translation: Texto y contornos blancos sobre negro con un acento amarillo, para personas con baja visión y habitaciones luminosas.
